card.name: Scattered words in technical passages
card.fires_on: No shared word or setting is clear. It fires on assorted words such as 'ated' in permeated, 'now' in 'from now on', 'after' before conversion, and 'administration' after a drug name.

modes.label: Word endings and links
modes.description: Fires on a word ending or small linking word in the middle of a technical sentence.
modes.example: The amount of perme<<ated>> water is insufficient to affect the solution significantly

card.plain: It responds to a mix of unrelated words, and no single pattern describes the passages it appears in.
